target.title: refactor(gateway): consolidate client contracts
target.body:
Related: #100977

## What Problem This Solves

The core gateway client and the shared gateway-client package maintained parallel option, event, error, validation, and connection-metadata contracts. That duplication made the internal client boundary easy to drift and required core-specific casts and repeated frame guards.

## Why This Change Was Made

This makes `@openclaw/gateway-client` the canonical client contract owner and moves lightweight frame validation to the published `@openclaw/gateway-protocol/frame-guards` leaf. The core `src/gateway/client.ts` facade now retains only OpenClaw-owned dependency injection and defaults, while existing source/package loaders resolve the new protocol leaf consistently.

## User Impact

No user-visible runtime behavior changes. Maintainers get one canonical gateway client contract path, preserved permissive frame handling, private connection secrets, and fewer duplicate declarations.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kww2w8yxsh0t0tqt4c1vtj4w`: 278 focused tests passed (18 package/protocol unit, 183 gateway, 77 plugin loader aliases).
- `@openclaw/gateway-protocol` build passed and emitted `frame-guards.mjs` plus declarations.
- `@openclaw/gateway-client` build passed.
- Repository root `OPENCLAW_RUN_NODE_SKIP_DTS_BUILD=1 node scripts/tsdown-build.mjs` passed.
- Targeted `oxfmt --check` and `git diff --check` passed.
- Fresh Codex autoreview reported no accepted/actionable findings (`patch is correct`, confidence 0.85).
- Broad `check:changed` passed pre-type guards but its repository-wide extension typecheck is blocked by untouched current-main/Testbox-sync failures in `extensions/qa-lab/src/cli.ts` (`./mantis/cli.js` absent) and Discord proxy WebSocket constructor test typing; this PR does not modify either path.
